title: VTG Kehlsteinhaus Souvenir Shot Glass With A Gold Rim
descriptionText: The VTG Kehlsteinhaus Souvenir Shot Glass with a gold rim is a collectible item made of glassware. This shot glass features a multicolor design and is perfect for any barware collection. The gold rim adds a touch of elegance to this unique and stylish souvenir.
